title: pandiaka debilis
intro: Pandiaka debilis, commonly known as  wild potato, is a plant species that belongs to the Solanaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antidiabetic properties. The therapeutic actions of Pandiaka debilis are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and improve glycemic control. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
